nodes.label: Multi-Provider AI Abstraction (ai-provider.js)
nodes.rationale: A single provider-agnostic AI layer fronts OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, selected by the AI_PROVIDER env var, so providers can be switched without code changes. OpenAI gpt-4o-mini is the default for fast/cost-effective resume parsing and quick matching; Anthropic claude-3-haiku is reserved for detailed analysis and complex matching. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY acts as a universal key across all three.

nodes.label: Resume Parser Service (AI Services Guide)
nodes.rationale: Uploads PDF/DOCX and extracts structured data (name, skills, experience, education) with AI to auto-populate the candidate profile. Parsed resumes are cached in the database and large files should be processed in background worker queues.

nodes.label: Job Scraper Service (AI Services Guide)
nodes.rationale: Scrapes Indeed (active) with LinkedIn/Glassdoor as placeholders pending API integration. Jobs are deduplicated on a unique externalId. MAX_JOBS_PER_SCRAPE caps volume because Indeed rate-limits and blocks; recommendation is scheduled cron scraping, caching and proxy rotation rather than real-time scraping.

nodes.label: Job Matcher Service (AI Services Guide)
nodes.rationale: AI compares candidate skills vs job requirements, experience level and location to return a 0-100 match score with matched skills, missing skills and reasoning. Matching costs 2-5s per job, so results are cached in the DB, batch endpoints exist, and cheaper models are used for initial filtering with complex models reserved for final matching.

nodes.label: Cover Letter Generator
nodes.rationale: Auto-generates a personalized cover letter per application from candidate profile plus job info; the user can review/edit it before submission.

nodes.label: Application Agent / Auto-Apply
nodes.rationale: Auto-applies to jobs whose match score exceeds MIN_MATCH_SCORE_FOR_AUTO_APPLY. Disabled by default (AUTO_APPLICATION_ENABLED=false) and gated by explicit user opt-in, complete profile, a daily cap (MAX_APPLICATIONS_PER_DAY) and application deduplication — these are deliberate safety brakes on an agent acting on the user's behalf. Should run as a scheduled batch job, not real-time.

nodes.label: Auto-Apply Safety Gates
nodes.rationale: Five layered constraints prevent runaway automated applications: complete-profile requirement, explicit user enablement, daily application limit, match score threshold, and deduplication. Master switch defaults to off.

nodes.label: AI Service Deployment Split (Monolith vs Microservices)
nodes.rationale: Current deployment is monolithic (Frontend <- Backend-with-AI <- MongoDB). Recommended at scale is an API Gateway fronting separate Auth/Job/AI/Application services so the AI service can be scaled independently, since AI matching is the slow, cost-dominant path.

nodes.label: API Key Management Policy
nodes.rationale: Never commit API keys. Use environment variables, gitignored .env files, and secret managers in production; rotate keys regularly and never share dev/prod keys.

nodes.label: Production Security Checklist
nodes.rationale: Before production: strong JWT_SECRET, HTTPS only, secure cookies, rate limiting, sanitized uploads, CSRF protection, input validation, secrets in env vars, MongoDB auth enabled, restricted CORS origins.
